content.title: Implement e2e API base URL constant extraction
content.description:
Execute the refactor planned in the Plan task under this chore. Follow the plan comment and the accepted review scope (mqiax8qo6l comment mqibe8euv8).

Do:
1. Add 'export' to E2E_BACKEND_URL in packages/webapp/e2e/setup.ts (no new constant, no Playwright baseURL conflation).
2. phase2-validation.spec.ts: import E2E_BACKEND_URL, replace all ~60 inline http://localhost:5001/... literals, preserving string quote style per occurrence.
3. phase1 / phase3 / phase4 / dashboard-roots / url-filters specs: remove local 'const BASE' and import the shared constant.
4. Do NOT touch playwright.config.ts, server/index.ts, frontend/vite.config.ts, e2e/global-setup.ts. No port changes.

Invariants: runner is 'npx playwright test' (never bunx); workers:1 / fullyParallel:false is load-bearing — do not perturb. At minimum run 'npx playwright test --list' to confirm config + all specs load after the refactor. Note: full regression needs port 5000 free (macOS AirPlay Receiver) — if unavailable, document that and leave the full run to the Validate task.

content.reason: Blocker issue mqibuy0y3q transitioned to done

content.content:
Done. Extracted the e2e API base URL into a single shared constant per the plan.

Summary
- Added `export` to `E2E_BACKEND_URL` in e2e/setup.ts (the only source of truth — no new constant, no Playwright baseURL conflation).
- phase2-validation.spec.ts: imported `E2E_BACKEND_URL` and replaced all 60 inline `http://localhost:5001/...` literals, preserving quote style (double-quoted became template literals; already-template-literal strings got a host-prefix swap only, keeping their existing interpolations intact).
- phase1, phase3, phase4, dashboard-roots, url-filters: removed the local `const BASE = "..."` declaration and imported the shared constant via an aliased import (`E2E_BACKEND_URL as BASE`) so all existing `${BASE}` call sites kept working untouched — minimal, mechanical diff.
- Out-of-scope files left alone: playwright.config.ts, server/index.ts, frontend/vite.config.ts, e2e/global-setup.ts. No port changes.

Verification
- `npx playwright test --list` succeeds: 176 tests across 6 spec files load cleanly (config + every spec compiles).
- Swept all e2e specs: zero remaining `http://localhost:5001` literals and zero local `const BASE` declarations outside setup.ts.
- Note: the webapp package exposes no `tsc`/`lint`/`test` npm scripts, so the project's stated gate (`playwright test --list`) is the authoritative compile/config check for this refactor.
- Full e2e regression was not run locally because port 5000 is held by macOS AirPlay Receiver (ControlCenter); the Validate task can run the full suite once 5000 is free.

Caveat
- e2e/global-setup.ts shows as modified in the working tree, but that change is pre-existing uncommitted work from a separate effort (it switches the isolation guard from /api/health to /api/status). I did NOT touch it — left as-is per the out-of-scope list.
